# Probity AI

> Tools and run records for checking claims about agent actions.

## Guides

- [Choose a project](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/start.html): Tools grouped by the task you need.
- [Automation](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/automation.html): Read the catalog and pinned run records.
- [Open Evidence Lab](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/lab.html): Retained runs, submissions and corrections.
- [Assurance atlas](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/atlas.html): Projects, mechanisms and evidence boundaries.
- [Experiments](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/experiments.html): Pinned procedures and recorded results.
- [Claim ledger](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/claims.html): Sources and re-derive commands.
- [Repository guide](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/repository.html): Sources, checks and the site build.

## Projects

- [Probity Admission](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-admission/blob/bbff435d11a7c0ec9bc0e8e65e6d8fc40c10b671/README.md): Provides OPA, Kyverno and policy-controller rules, plus a pre-call budget reservation API and CLI for bounded local workloads.
- [Probity Atlas](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-atlas/blob/89aea5fd58850247da3aab9e0e539c20625de35b/README.md): Provides task-based project navigation, agent assurance documentation and an Open Evidence Lab run register.
- [dsse](https://github.com/probityai/dsse/blob/fa96f343623a520c38cb213c1315ee9bfa1bb3c0/README.md): Signs and verifies DSSE envelopes with explicit threshold and key handling.
- [jcs-admit](https://github.com/probityai/jcs-admit/blob/b3ecf0a36d6e72eef1ee808678811f42787f2c23/README.md): Checks raw JSON input before producing its RFC 8785 canonical form.
- [Probity Observer](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-observer/blob/1ec93df92b49239175147c2b9f3ccda87a090cd1/README.md): Records brokered file actions with signed packets and history, and reads selected native delegation evidence offline.
- [Probity Vectors](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/308c5b4401b18d42ed73dea80459375932e6b8e8/README.md): Provides conformance cases and reference verifiers for selected agent evidence formats.
- [Probity Verify](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/437e484bd81e3d1eb1b9ad7230124a434a7a0ef6/README.md): Checks supplied evidence bytes through claim-specific offline adapters. Its README links to source-pinned installation and checked task recipes.
- [Probity Vocabulary](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/8c80579ae613d7ae07982321e13a6091c402b2a8/README.md): Defines versioned terms and crosswalks for claims about agent execution.

## Data

- [Project catalog](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/catalog.json): Stable project IDs, tasks and pinned README sources.
- [Lab register](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/lab/register.json): Retained artifacts, results and review state.
